title: Review: anticancer natural products from the Middle East and North Africa
body: Our new review in Frontiers in Oncology surveys the region's biodiversity as a source of anticancer compounds, how they work, and what stands between them and the clinic.

title: Focused ultrasound boosts hippocampal neurogenesis
body: With the Khraiche lab, we report in Ultrasound in Medicine & Biology that low-intensity focused ultrasound enhances the birth of new neurons through BDNF pathways.

title: ONC212 leads the imipridones in androgen-independent prostate cancer
body: Published in the International Journal of Molecular Sciences: combined phenotypic and transcriptomic profiling positions ONC212 as the lead imipridone in androgen-independent prostate cancer models.

title: Sustaining research in crisis settings
body: In BMJ Global Health, we share lessons from sustaining research in Lebanon through years of crisis.

title: Abdul Hameed Shoman Award for Arab Researchers
body: Dr. Wassim Abou-Kheir received the 2025 Abdul Hameed Shoman Award for Arab Researchers, in the field of stem cells for incurable diseases.

title: Dean's Excellence Award for Research
body: Dr. Wassim Abou-Kheir received the Faculty of Medicine Dean's Excellence Award for Research.

title: Dean's Excellence Award for Lama Hachem
body: Lama Hachem received the Dean's Excellence Award with the graduating class of 2026.

title: Penrose Award for Joe Youssef
body: Joe Youssef received the Penrose Award with the class of 2026.

title: Best SCT basic science research project
body: Joe Youssef won first place for the best SCT basic science research project.

title: ASN Kidney STARS Award for Tala Kaddoura
body: Tala Kaddoura received a Kidney STARS Award from the American Society of Nephrology.

title: Tala Kaddoura heads to Lindau
body: Tala Kaddoura was selected to represent the AUB Faculty of Medicine at the 75th Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting in Germany.

title: First place at the first MENA Three Minute Thesis
body: Layal Jaafar won first place at the first MENA Three Minute Thesis (3MT) competition, held in Qatar.

title: Two prizes at the USEK Doctoral Studies Days
body: At the USEK Doctoral Studies Days (Middle East edition), Layal Jaafar won first prize for the best poster in applied and fundamental sciences, and Tala Kaddoura won third prize for the best oral presentation in fundamental sciences.

title: Two prizes for Christina Kourie
body: Christina Kourie received the Abdul Hadi Debs Endowment Award and the Dean Thomas Sutherland Prize.

title: Four WAKers win the MS/PhD Thesis Pitch Competition
body: Fatima Ghamlouche, Lama Hachem, Maram Chaaban and Rana El-Hassan were among the winners of the 2025 MS/PhD Thesis Pitch Competition.

title: Best poster at Biomedical Research Day
body: Tala Kaddoura and Alaa Al Mikkawi won the best poster presentation award at Biomedical Research Day 2025.

title: Best presentation at the Urology Research Forum
body: Alaa Al Mikkawi won the best presentation award at the 9th Urology Research Forum at AUBMC.

title: AΩA student research fellowship for Aya Yatim
body: Aya Yatim received the Alpha Omega Alpha Carolyn L. Kuckein Student Research Fellowship.

title: Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds travel grant
body: Tala Kaddoura received a travel grant from the Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds.

title: French Embassy mobility grant for Layal Jaafar
body: Layal Jaafar received a High-Level Scientific Stay mobility grant from the French Embassy in Lebanon.

title: PHC CEDRE funding for the AUB–Montpellier collaboration
body: Amani Yehya secured PHC CEDRE 2026 mobility funding for the lab's research collaboration with the University of Montpellier.

title: Medical student research awards for Joe Youssef
body: Joe Youssef received the Suheil Jamil Muasher Endowed Medical Student Research Award and support from the Naji Sahyoun Endowed Memorial Fund.

title: Graduate Student Conference Awards
body: Lama Hachem and Rawan Khadra each received a Graduate Student Conference Award.

title: Poster at the FENS Forum
body: Dr. Wassim Abou-Kheir and Alaa Al Mikkawi presented a poster at the FENS Forum of Neuroscience.

title: Talks at Hamad Bin Khalifa University
body: Maya Atwi and Razane Hamiyeh presented their research at Hamad Bin Khalifa University in Qatar.

title: Poster at the 16th 3R Meeting in France
body: Amani Yehya presented a poster at the 16th 3R Meeting in La Grande Motte, France.

title: Poster at the Festschrift for Dr. Fadlo Khuri
body: Fatima Ghamlouche presented a poster at the Festschrift honoring Fadlo R. Khuri, MD.

title: Three posters at EACR 2025 in Lisbon
body: Amani Yehya, Fatima Ghamlouche and Zahraa Salhab presented posters at the EACR 2025 Congress in Lisbon, Portugal.

title: Talk at the German-Arab bioinformatics workshop
body: Fatima Ghamlouche presented her research at the 5th International Bioinformatics Workshop of the German-Arab Research Network for Computational Life Science.

title: The WAKers' Men's Health Awareness Event
body: An interactive prostate cancer awareness event for the Faculty of Medicine, with educational and recreational activities that promote awareness and early detection.
